name: Humaiz Malik
description: The personal website of Humaiz Malik. Projects, ideas, and a little about me.
intro: My work, ideas, and what comes next.
about: Welcome to my personal corner of the web. This is a place for the things I build, the subjects I explore, and the work I want to share.
My current project is EMREE Study, a browser-based question bank for exam practice. As I add new projects and experiences, you’ll find them here.

projects.name: EMREE Study
projects.description: An interactive question bank with 120 original practice questions across seven subjects. Includes instant marking, a timed exam mode, search, flags, and saved progress.
